runner_contract.exit_code_semantics: 0 = execution completed regardless of behavior_pass; non-zero only for genuine executor failure (behavior failure is never a numerical failure)

sizing_rule: per-asset frozen numerics derive from prior longest_dimension_m: scale_m=clamp(L,0.02,2.0), particle_size_m=scale/24 (MPM only), dt_s=0.001, substeps=16, grid_density=64, seed=17, drop_height_m=min(0.5*scale,0.25), proxy_mode=alpha-wrap; cloth routes treat particle_size_m/grid_density as not_applicable
mutable_parameter_bounds: per-prior valid_range, falling back to routing.DEFAULT_PARAMETER_BOUNDS; proposers may introduce whitelisted parameters absent from the prior

proposers.qwen: VLM-in-the-loop via code/scripts/qwen_proposer_transport.py (qwen3.8-max, DashScope-compatible); whitelist-validated bounded patch; unavailable -> structured proposer_unavailable, never silent

calibration.simulation_calibrated_means: behavior contract pass only; not material ground truth

acceptance.elastic_budget: extra iterations are earned only while calibration loss keeps improving (>=5% relative per step); every escalation is a trace event; stalled loops stop at the base budget
acceptance.behavior_contract: finite + contact + settled + deformation/recovery within band; thresholds are scale-relative (particle size, grid cell, asset height, peak speed)

render_policy.note: rendering disabled by default in the rebuild runner; frames are not evidence

mesh_normalization_rule: surface mesh is decimated or voxelized by Genesis preprocessor; normalized asset unit scaled by metric scale rule
scale_rule: metric scale comes from VLM prior or family fallback; never claimed as measured ground truth

status_mapping.note: accepted_first_pass counts as prior-compatible only, never as correction success

family_capability_gate: unsupported routes terminate as rejected_model_limit with explicit evidence; no fallback to a generic model; MPM solid and PBD cloth routes are implemented
claim_boundary: simulator-grounded behavior contract; not measured material ground truth

qualification_evidence.scope: local 10-asset qualification (6 MPM solids + 4 cloth-routed), multi-GPU workers, VLM-in-the-loop (Qwen)
qualification_evidence.output_root: local qualification workspace (non-release scratch; not an identity reference)
qualification_evidence.note: qualification is a partial, non-publishable subset; it is not a release; the uncertain task escalated on a Qwen transport timeout and is re-runnable

change_log: 2026-09-17: v12.2 frozen for the rebuilt verifier-guided agent. Differences from v12.1 (the 2026-09-07 production batch contract, kept frozen in method_contract.json): real behavior-contract runner (drop + compression with behavior metrics and bounded diagnosis) replaces the stability-only probe; Qwen VLM-in-the-loop proposer added alongside RuleTune; sizing rule derives per-asset numerics from prior scale; status mapping fixed (five agent states -> three formal states; numerical failure no longer misclassified as uncertain); behavior-failure vs executor-failure exit semantics separated; model-limit capability gate short-circuits; proposer may introduce whitelisted parameters absent from the prior.

2026-09-21: v12.5-candidate proposal (NOT frozen). Adds the mesh_adaptation v3 layer (see mesh_adaptation field). Numerics/thresholds of v12.2 are unchanged; the contract additions are: (1) proxy quality gate -> model_limit for unfit proxies (explicit, auditable); (2) engagement servo making the compression stimulus achieve its commanded ratio on the body; (3) recovery reference fallback for zero-height flat proxies (fixes a NaN metric, not a threshold); (4) contact-gated lateral CoM dissipation as a declared contact-friction surrogate. Requires gate-study calibration review before freezing; in particular the cloth deformation lower bound at exactly 0.0 rejects noise-level negative drift (observed -2e-4) and should get an epsilon from the gate-study window.

mesh_adaptation.opt_in: probe config or simulator config carries mesh_adaptation="v3"; default path remains v12.2
mechanisms: float32-aware vertex welding + degenerate/duplicate face removal (source hygiene)
MPM filled_volume: voxelize+closing+fill+marching cubes, watertight-verified, convex hull fallback with warning; watertight bag sources keep their boundary (v11 policy)

cloth: cloth_sheet flat grid mid-surface; sealed shells get bounded opening surgery; fragmented non-watertight sources are voxel-sealed (binary closing seals sub-pitch gaps) then opened; projected mid-surface fallback; dust-body filtering on multi-body seals

proxy quality report in metrics.mesh_adaptation (source + proxy: watertight, components, boundary edges, area/volume, aspect ratio, thinness) with verdict ok/degraded/unfit; unfit gates to model_limit with explicit defects; post-build particle/vertex floor gates
MPM hooks: InternalVelocityRelaxation (CoM-preserving) + ContactNormalDissipation (upward, contact+window gated) + v12.5 contact-gated lateral CoM dissipation (contact-friction surrogate)
cloth hook: post-contact exponential velocity damping
cloth compression: plate lift inside the PBD contact shell + near-zero plate friction (floor friction pinned the kinematic plates at small scales)
compression engagement servo (v3): plates chase the measured body axis extent to the commanded ratio with a gap floor; release retracts to the initial gap
recovery reference fallback: flat proxies with z_pre ~ 0 use compression-axis-extent recovery (thresholds unchanged)

MPM solver-scale normalization: scale_eff=min(scale_m, 0.5) with scale/24 particle ratio preserved — measured grid-coupling floor penetration at scale>=0.64 (clean icosphere: +0.010m at 0.5, -0.66m at 1.9) independent of particle_size; contract thresholds are scale-relative so the behavior contract is unchanged

cloth scenes use the Genesis default rigid constraint_timeconst (0.01) — the v12.2 value (2*dt/substeps) makes kinematic compression plates yield to contact resistance and never engage (measured bisect on garment_000933)
cloth compression plates: friction=0.01 (Genesis minimum) + lift within the PBD contact shell — the v12.2 lift (0.5*MPM particle size) floated plates over thin sheets

PBD bending REMAINS disabled (v12.5 re-tested enabling it with the v11 compliance cap: drop probes destabilized, garment/shell lost floor contact entirely — evidence in deployment/experiments/mesh_adapt)
